title: onprem/airgap: add offline bundle support for RKE2 + Flatcar Linux and vendor runtime tooling
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in air-gapped/on-prem environments have requested first-class support for RKE2 (Rancher Kubernetes Engine 2) and Flatcar Linux as a host OS. Existing offline bundle generation only targeted upstream k8s distro images and cloud-native distros; RKE2 bundles require vendorized containerd/crictl tooling and a different systemd/service layout. This PR adds generation support to the offline bundle, vendors required runtime binaries, and updates installer Helm charts and Terraform module docs. What changed: 1) bundle-generator: add rke2 and flatcar profiles, new image index (manifest) entries, and per-distro asset lists; 2) vendor/: added containerd 1.7.x and crictl binaries, rke2 bootstrap manifests, and precomputed image layers for k3s/rke2/etcd/coredns images to reduce online pulls; 3) helm/redwood-private: template changes to honor RKE2-specific tolerations/nodeSelector and to install rke2 bootstrap manifests when rke2 profile is selected; 4) terraform/modules/onprem: expose new variable `kube_distro` and document upgrade/rollback semantics for airgap installs; 5) installer/upgrade: add checksums and signature verification for vendored artifacts, fallback logic for missing hostctl systemctl variants. Testing and validation: - Local end-to-end airgap flow exercised in CI using a k3s/RKE2 matrix in smoke stage (airgap-sim job). - Manual validation on Flatcar edge node VMs (bootstrapped using Ignition) reproducing an entire offline install with DB migration. - Added unit tests for bundle index generation and checksum verification. Rollout plan: land changes to canary first, generate an offline bundle and smoke-install against a staging RKE2 cluster, then coordinate with SolutionsEng for customer rollouts. Checklist: [x] bundle generation logic updated [x] vendored binaries added and checksummed [x] helm templates updated [x] terraform docs updated [x] CI jobs extended [x] smoke-tested on Flatcar and RKE2 Known limitations: the Flatcar image set is limited to v3459+ due to systemd/networkd changes; we document this in the release notes. Backwards compatibility: existing k3s and upstream flows unchanged unless `kube_distro` is set to rke2. Related: ENG-1729, ENG-1883, SUP-5122.

release_notes: Added RKE2 and Flatcar Linux support to the on-prem offline bundle. Vendored containerd and crictl binaries with checksum/signature verification. New terraform variable `kube_distro` enables selecting distro-specific install behavior. See docs/onprem/airgap/rke2-flatcar.md for constraints and upgrade notes.
notes: This PR expands the offline bundle format (bundle format v2->v3). Upgrade tooling will detect older bundle versions and refuse unsafe upgrades; see docs for migration steps. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering for customer-specific images and signatures.
